content.title: National Weather Service
content.text: TonightMostly cloudy, with a low around 33. North wind 11 to 16 mph decreasing to 5 to 10 mph after midnight. ThursdayA chance of rain and snow showers before 1pm, then rain showers likely. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 39. Light and variable wind becoming southeast around 6 mph in the afternoon. Chance of precipitation is 60%. Little or no snow accumulation expected. Thursday NightShowers. The rain could be heavy at times. Low around 36. South wind 9 to 16 mph, with gusts as high as 29 mph. Chance of precipitation is 80%. New precipitation amounts between a tenth and quarter of an inch possible. FridayA 40 percent chance of showers before 2pm. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 64. Breezy, with a south wind 16 to 20 mph, with gusts as high as 34 mph. New precipitation amounts of less than a tenth of an inch possible. Friday NightMostly cloudy, with a low around 41. South wind 6 to 9 mph becoming north after midnight. SaturdayA 40 percent chance of showers after 2pm. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 57. North wind around 6 mph. New precipitation amounts of less than a tenth of an inch possible. Saturday NightShowers, mainly after 8pm. Low around 45. South wind 11 to 17 mph. Chance of precipitation is 80%.SundayShowers, mainly before 2pm. High near 57. South wind 11 to 14 mph. Chance of precipitation is 80%.Sunday NightA 30 percent chance of showers before 8pm. Mostly cloudy, with a low around 34. West wind around 9 mph. MondayPartly sunny, with a high near 46. Northwest wind around 10 mph. Monday NightMostly cloudy, with a low around 28. Northwest wind around 6 mph. TuesdayPartly sunny, with a high near 41. North wind 6 to 10 mph. Tuesday NightPartly cloudy, with a low around 23. Northwest wind around 7 mph. WednesdaySunny, with a high near 44. Northeast wind 6 to 8 mph.
